Q5651.reason: An as-is clause leaves intact the express warranty from the ad's description of a 1964 Thunderbird, so Carol can recover for the 1968 car.

Q5672.reason: Self-defense justifies the killing, so no crime occurred and the instigator has no derivative murder liability.

Q8537.reason: The concept is separated from justification so a definition of punishment stays value-neutral and does not presuppose a moral warrant.
